page: Microsoft Azure D192s_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor. The hardware configuration delivers 192 vCPUs across 96 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, supported by 768.0 GB of system memory, which translates to a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or onboard GPUs, relying instead on its Premium Storage compatibility for external disk resources.

Benchmark data highlights the server's massive parallel processing capabilities, with multi-core performance metrics ranking in the top tier. The stress-ng multi-core CPU test and PassMark CPU score both place in the top 10% of tested systems. This compute density is complemented by high-speed memory architecture, achieving top-tier read-only large block memory bandwidth of 510.75 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 215.02 GB/sec. Single-core performance, however, remains in the average tier, indicating that the server's strength lies in highly threaded workloads rather than single-threaded execution speed.

The Intel Xeon processor includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate cryptographic, vector, and deep learning operations. This is reflected in strong benchmark results for medium-model LLM inference and top-tier performance in database operations, Redis SET operations (173.14 million operations per second), and static web serving throughput (188.19 GB/sec). The server is highly suited for large-scale enterprise applications, multi-threaded database hosting, high-throughput web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
description: The Microsoft Azure D192s_v6 is a high-capacity, general-purpose virtual machine from the Dsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8573C processor, it features 192 vCPUs (96 physical cores) and 768.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. While it lacks local storage and GPUs, it supports Premium Storage for external disk needs. Benchmarks show top-tier multi-core performance, with exceptional memory bandwidth and high-throughput database operations. The processor's support for AVX-512 and Intel AMX instructions enhances vector and matrix math, making this instance highly efficient for parallelized workloads. It is best suited for large-scale database hosting, high-volume Redis deployments, static web serving, and multi-threaded enterprise applications.
